prompt: High-angle 65° view of a generous four-portion bake in a white gratin dish, food filling the square frame, edges cropped, serving spoon resting in the food. A patchy crust of coarse jagged 0.2–0.5 cm panko flakes, crisp and uneven deep golden-brown, and melted grated cheese with deep gold, amber and toasted-brown spots. Below: tender, plump, pale creamy-yellow 2 cm potato gnocchi with shallow ridges; very dark, almost black-green, soft 2–4 cm crinkled curly kale; soft silky creamy-white and pale yellow-green leek strips; irregular 0.5–0.8 cm smoked-bacon dice with greyish rosy-brown lean patches and translucent cream rendered fat. Thick, spoon-coating, smooth ivory cream sauce coats the bake in shallow pools; exposed gnocchi tops are only lightly golden. Faint steam, natural sheen, light wood, bright soft natural daylight, crisp true-colour magazine-cover food photography. No garnish, text, logos, hands or people.

visible_ingredients.real_life_appearance: Blanched, chopped and baked: very dark, almost black-green and soft, with crinkled curly surfaces and moist cut edges; irregular 2–4 cm leaf pieces, roughly 25–35 per portion in the bake, only a few exposed on top. Much darker and softer than raw kale, not smooth pale cabbage.

Briefly sweated, then baked: soft silky strips, creamy white with pale yellow-green sections, glossy with butter and sauce, with little or no browning; 0.2–0.3 cm wide and 4–6 cm long, roughly 30–40 strips per portion, about 10–15 visible near the surface.

Briefly sweated, then baked: irregular 0.5–0.8 cm smoked-bacon dice with greyish rosy-brown lean patches and translucent cream rendered fat, lightly browned edges and a soft-chewy, lightly glossy surface; several dozen per portion, roughly 8–12 visible on top. Distinct fat seams, not uniform pink ham cubes.

Unfried potato dumplings baked directly in the sauce: tender, plump, pale creamy-yellow 2 cm potato gnocchi with shallow ridges and a thumb dimple; about 20–25 per portion. Sauce-coated below, with exposed tops only lightly golden and no crisp seared crust.

Baked on top: coarse jagged 0.2–0.5 cm flakes, crisp and uneven deep golden-brown with a few lighter cream flecks; a loose dry scattering, about 10 g and dozens of visible flakes per portion, not fine sandy crumbs.

Melted into the topping: melted grated cheese with deep gold, amber and toasted-brown spots, tiny crisp lacy edges and softer glossy melted patches; about 15 g per portion, the fine shreds mostly fused rather than separately visible, not a continuous thick cheese blanket.
Thick, spoon-coating, smooth ivory cream sauce, lightly glossy and not runny; it coats the ingredients and forms shallow pools in gaps and around the spoon, roughly 75–90 ml per portion.
